project.title: G9v3.5 Physics pilot
project.subtitle: Newton's Laws pilot on the ZIP-free track, and the owner-bank guard (PR #305)
project.aim: A personal-use app for one Grade 9 kid to self-learn difficult Physics, Mathematics and Chemistry concepts for one of the toughest competitive exams. Not a corporate product.

M0.name: Baseline + first NLM interaction
M0.full: A few baseline attempts (2–3 existing prompts) plus ONE identified NLM question with staged hints, reasoning route and teacher answer. Report distinct technical checks and actual learner observations separately; preserve source identity and assistance/exposure history.

M1.name: NLM Core 1A/1B
M1.full: Each fixed pilot tile has a concept-building lesson and a matching inference-before-reveal task, checked as a pair; coverage and gaps are explicit.

M2.name: NLM questionnaire refinement
M2.full: Refine Core 1B/2B diagnostics using observed attempts after the first working learning path. Initial baseline and demand capture already occur in M0; they do not wait for this fuller questionnaire.

M3.name: NLM Core 2B
M3.full: Changed-demand transfer items address the observed gaps; a distinct spot-check covers the new decision and reveal behavior, followed by a learner retry.

M4.name: Next Physics topic (deferred)
M4.full: After the NLM learner cycle, select the next Physics topic from observed need and repeat the small pipeline; Mathematics and Chemistry remain later work.
